newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.3 bln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.3 bln for Wednesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday, May 21 are expected to total $1.3 billion in 33 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.1 billion in 13 sales, with a $739 million New York City general obligations deal through Lehman Brothers is topping the list.
On the competitive side, 20 sales totaling $185 million are on the schedule. A $39 million Snohomish County, Wash., issue at 1300 EDT is the largest.
An additional four sales totaling $72 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Wednesday depending on market conditions.
